item.text: [{"task_id":"2601afb7","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    color_shift = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    height_shift = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    vertical_direction = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    columns = []","    colors = []","    heights = []","    for column, values in enumerate(grid.T):","        occupied = np.argwhere(values != background).flatten()","        if len(occupied) > 0:","            columns.append(column)","            colors.append(int(values[occupied[0]]))","            heights.append(len(occupied))","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    count = len(columns)","    for index, column in enumerate(columns):","        color = colors[(index + color_shift) % count]","        height = heights[(index + height_shift) % count]","        if vertical_direction > 0:","            result[len(grid) - height:, column] = color","        else:","            result[:height, column] = color","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[4]},"params":{"rule":[7,-1,1,1]},"rationale":"Keep the occupied columns fixed.
